compose.title.new.description: The title of the post composer when it writes a new post.

compose.title.reply.description: The title of the post composer when it writes a reply to a post.

compose.title.quote.description: The title of the post composer when it writes a post that quotes another.

compose.title.edit.description: The title of the post composer when it edits the reader's post.

compose.edit.fixed.defaultMessage: {visibility} · Una edición no puede cambiar quién la ve
compose.edit.fixed.description: The one line at the top of the composer while it edits a post, naming what an edit cannot change; visibility is the post's visibility (compose.visibility.*).

compose.close.description: The button at the end of the composer's head that leaves it; a written post is discarded, with Undo.

compose.load_failed.defaultMessage: No se pudo cargar el formulario de publicación.
compose.load_failed.description: In place of the post composer when its code could not be loaded (the network), beside compose.load_retry.

compose.editor_failed.defaultMessage: No se pudo cargar el campo de texto.
compose.editor_failed.description: In place of the composer's text or content warning field when its code could not be loaded (the network), beside compose.load_retry.

compose.load_retry.description: After compose.load_failed or compose.editor_failed: loads the composer or its field again.

compose.post.description: The composer's primary button, which posts what is written.

compose.save.description: The composer's primary button while it edits the reader's post: it saves the edit.

compose.saved.description: The notice at the bottom of the page after the composer saved an edit of the reader's post and closed; the post shows the edit everywhere.

compose.save_failed.defaultMessage: No se pudo guardar. Inténtalo de nuevo.
compose.save_failed.description: The error before Save when an edit of the reader's post got no answer from the server (the network); pressing Save sends it again.

compose.text.placeholder.description: The placeholder of the composer's empty text.

compose.text.label.description: The name of the composer's text field, for assistive technology.

compose.cw.label.description: The name of the content warning field, for assistive technology.

compose.cw.placeholder.defaultMessage: De qué se advierte a quien lee
compose.cw.placeholder.description: The placeholder of the content warning field: the warning readers see before they open the post.

compose.cw.on.description: The tool of the composer's row that adds a content warning field.

compose.cw.off.description: The same tool while the post has a content warning: it removes it.

compose.emoji.description: The button at the end of the composer's text that opens the emoji picker, which writes the emoji picked at the caret; also the title of the picker's sheet on a phone.

compose.suggest.list.description: The name, for assistive technology, of the suggestions that open under the line of the composer's text for the word being typed at the caret: accounts for @, hashtags for #, emoji for :. kind is account, hashtag or emoji.

compose.suggest.account.description: The name, for assistive technology, of an account among the composer's suggestions, which shows its avatar, name and handle on one row. name is its display name in words (custom emoji as their :shortcode:); handle is @user for a local account, @user@domain for another server's.

compose.suggest.uses.description: At the end of a hashtag's row among the composer's suggestions: how many posts carry the hashtag. count is how many.

compose.suggest.hashtag.description: The name, for assistive technology, of a hashtag among the composer's suggestions: the tag with its # sign, and how many posts carry it. name is the tag without #; count is how many.

compose.suggest.loading.description: The one line in place of the composer's suggestions while they are asked for, after a moment; also announced.

compose.suggest.none.defaultMessage: {kind, select, account {No hay cuentas que coincidan} hashtag {No hay etiquetas que coincidan} other {No hay emojis que coincidan}}
compose.suggest.none.description: The one line in place of the composer's suggestions when none match the word being typed at the caret; also announced. The word can still be posted as typed. kind is account, hashtag or emoji.

compose.suggest.count.description: Announced to assistive technology when the composer's suggestions open or change: how many there are (the text field cannot say it is expanded). count is how many, at least 1.

compose.attach.description: The tool of the composer's row that opens the file picker to attach images (or a video or an audio file).

compose.poll.on.description: The tool of the composer's row that adds a poll to the post.

compose.poll.off.description: The same tool while the post has a poll, and the remove of the poll's card.

compose.poll.option.description: The placeholder and the name of a poll's option. n is its place, from 1.

compose.poll.remove_option.description: The button at the end of a poll's option that takes it out. n is its place, from 1.

compose.poll.add.description: The last line of a poll's options, which adds one.

compose.poll.duration.description: The name of the poll's duration choices.

compose.poll.ends_in.description: The poll's duration control, as it reads. duration is one of the choices (5 minutes, 1 day).

compose.poll.minutes.description: A choice of the poll's duration, in minutes; also what the duration control reads.

compose.poll.hours.description: A choice of the poll's duration, in hours.

compose.poll.days.description: A choice of the poll's duration, in days.

compose.poll.multiple.description: The checkbox of the poll that lets a vote choose several options.

compose.poll.hide_totals.defaultMessage: Ocultar los recuentos hasta que termine
compose.poll.hide_totals.description: The checkbox of the poll that hides how many voted for each option until it ends.

compose.poll.invalid.defaultMessage: Una encuesta necesita de {min} a {max} opciones distintas de como máximo {length} caracteres cada una, y debe durar de 5 minutos a 30 días.
compose.poll.invalid.description: The error before Post when the poll has a blank option or two the same; the server's own words (errors.status.poll_invalid).

compose.audience.description: The caption of the visibility choices in the audience menu, and the name of the menu's tool.

compose.audience.tool.defaultMessage: {visibility, select, public {Quién puede verla: Público} local {Quién puede verla: Vecinos} unlisted {Quién puede verla: Público discreto} private {Quién puede verla: Solo seguidores} other {Quién puede verla: Directo}}{limited, select, yes {, con respuestas, impulsos o citas limitados} other {}}
compose.audience.tool.description: The name of the audience tool for assistive technology: the post's visibility, and whether who may interact is limited. The visibilities are the post's (Public, Neighbors, Quiet public, Followers only, Direct).

compose.audience.everyone.description: A choice of the permissions submenu: anyone who may see the post. Also in the options of Who can reply, Who can boost and Who can quote on the Display and posting page of the settings (settings.display.reply, settings.display.boost, settings.display.quote).

compose.audience.followers.description: A choice of the permissions submenu: the author's followers and the accounts the post mentions. Also in the options of Who can reply, Who can boost and Who can quote on the Display and posting page of the settings (settings.display.reply, settings.display.boost, settings.display.quote).

compose.audience.mentioned.description: A choice of the permissions submenu: the accounts the post mentions. Also in the options of Who can reply, Who can boost and Who can quote on the Display and posting page of the settings (settings.display.reply, settings.display.boost, settings.display.quote).

compose.audience.nobody.description: A choice of the permissions submenu: the author alone. Also in the options of Who can reply, Who can boost and Who can quote on the Display and posting page of the settings (settings.display.reply, settings.display.boost, settings.display.quote).

compose.approval.defaultMessage: Permitir a otras personas con tu aprobación
compose.approval.description: A checkbox under the audiences of reply, boost or quote in the permissions submenu: people outside the chosen audience may still do it, once the author approves.

compose.permission.now.defaultMessage: {audience}{approval, select, yes {, otras personas con tu aprobación} other {}}
compose.permission.now.description: Who may reply, boost or quote, as a value: audience is one of the audiences (Anyone, Followers, People you mention, Only you); approval is yes when others may do it once the author approves (compose.approval). Also each option of Who can reply, Who can boost and Who can quote on the Display and posting page of the settings (settings.display.reply, settings.display.boost, settings.display.quote): every audience alone, and every audience but Anyone with approval yes.

compose.visibility.public.description: A visibility in the audience menu; the same word as a post's visibility glyph. Also an option of Who can see it on the Display and posting page of the settings (settings.display.audience), the visibility a new post starts with.

compose.visibility.local.description: A visibility in the audience menu: people on this server, and the author's followers on other servers. It names whom the author speaks to. Also an option of Who can see it on the Display and posting page of the settings (settings.display.audience), the visibility a new post starts with.

compose.visibility.unlisted.description: A visibility in the audience menu: anyone with the link or the author's profile, kept off the timelines and hashtags. Also an option of Who can see it on the Display and posting page of the settings (settings.display.audience), the visibility a new post starts with.

compose.visibility.private.description: A visibility in the audience menu: the author's followers and the accounts the post mentions. Also an option of Who can see it on the Display and posting page of the settings (settings.display.audience), the visibility a new post starts with.

compose.visibility.direct.description: A visibility in the audience menu: the accounts the post mentions alone. Also an option of Who can see it on the Display and posting page of the settings (settings.display.audience), only while it is the visibility the account's new posts start with.

compose.visibility.public.about.defaultMessage: Cualquiera en cualquier servidor, también en las cronologías y etiquetas
compose.visibility.public.about.description: The line under Public in the audience menu: who sees the post. Also the line under Who can see it on the Display and posting page of the settings while this visibility is the one chosen there.

compose.visibility.local.about.defaultMessage: Personas de {server} y tus seguidores en otros servidores
compose.visibility.local.about.description: The line under Neighbors in the audience menu. server is this server's domain. Also the line under Who can see it on the Display and posting page of the settings while this visibility is the one chosen there.

compose.visibility.unlisted.about.defaultMessage: Cualquiera con el enlace o tu perfil, sin aparecer en las cronologías ni etiquetas
compose.visibility.unlisted.about.description: The line under Quiet public in the audience menu. Also the line under Who can see it on the Display and posting page of the settings while this visibility is the one chosen there.

compose.visibility.private.about.defaultMessage: Tus seguidores y las personas que menciones
compose.visibility.private.about.description: The line under Followers only in the audience menu. Also the line under Who can see it on the Display and posting page of the settings while this visibility is the one chosen there.

compose.visibility.direct.about.description: The line under Direct in the audience menu. Also the line under Who can see it on the Display and posting page of the settings while this visibility is the one chosen there.

compose.interactions.defaultMessage: Quién puede responder, impulsar y citar
compose.interactions.description: The name of the audience menu's second group, apart from the visibilities, for assistive technology: who may reply to, boost and quote the post.

compose.permissions.defaultMessage: Quién puede responder, impulsar y citar
compose.permissions.description: The row of the audience menu that opens the submenu of who may reply to, boost and quote the post, and the submenu's title beside its back button.

compose.interaction.reply.description: A row of the permissions submenu, beside who may reply to the post now, and the title of the panel it opens (its audiences), beside its back button.

compose.interaction.announce.description: A row of the permissions submenu, beside who may boost the post now, and the title of the panel it opens (its audiences), beside its back button.

compose.interaction.quote.description: A row of the permissions submenu, beside who may quote the post now, and the title of the panel it opens (its audiences), beside its back button.

compose.language.description: The caption of the language menu of the composer, and the start of its tool's name for assistive technology.

compose.language.tool.description: The name of the composer's language tool for assistive technology. language is the post's language, by its name in its own words.

compose.remaining.description: What the composer's count says to assistive technology while the post is within its limit.

compose.over.defaultMessage: {count, plural, one {# carácter de más} other {# caracteres de más}}
compose.over.description: What the composer's count says to assistive technology once the post is past its limit.

compose.too_long.defaultMessage: {max, plural, one {El texto y la advertencia de contenido deben tener como máximo # carácter.} other {El texto y la advertencia de contenido deben tener como máximo # caracteres.}}
compose.too_long.description: The error under the composer's text once it is past the limit; the server's own words (errors.status.text_too_long).

compose.quote_remote.defaultMessage: Para citar una publicación de otro servidor, haz que esta publicación sea Público o Público discreto.
compose.quote_remote.description: The note under the visibilities when the post quotes a post from another server, whose other visibilities are disabled: which ones to choose.

compose.replying_to.description: What the post replied to says to assistive technology, above the composer's text. handle is its author's, as @user@domain.

compose.on_board.description: Over the composer's text when it writes a post on an event's board, as a reply's context line (compose.replying_to): title is the event's title, as its organizers wrote it, or the words of notifications.untitled_event when it has none.

compose.reply_waits.defaultMessage: Las demás personas verán tu respuesta cuando {handle} la apruebe
compose.reply_waits.description: A line over the send row while writing a reply to a post whose author approves replies by hand: until that author approves it, only the writer sees the reply. handle is the author's, as @user@domain.

compose.quote.remove.description: The button on the quoted post in the composer that takes it out of the post.

compose.description.description: The label of an image's description (alternative text) beside it in the composer.

compose.description.hint.defaultMessage: Qué muestra la imagen, para quienes no pueden verla
compose.description.hint.description: The placeholder of an image's description in the composer.

compose.description.missing.description: The caution under an image's empty description in the composer.

compose.description.required.defaultMessage: Este servidor exige una descripción (texto alternativo) para cada imagen. Añade una a cada imagen antes de publicar.
compose.description.required.description: The error under an image's empty description when the server asks for one, after Post was pressed; the server's own words (errors.status.missing_media_description).

compose.description.required.own.defaultMessage: Tu configuración exige una descripción (texto alternativo) para cada imagen. Añade una a cada imagen antes de publicar.
compose.description.required.own.description: The error under an image's empty description, after Post was pressed, when the server does not ask for descriptions and the reader's own setting does (Require media descriptions on the Display and posting page of the settings, settings.display.media_description); compose.description.required with the reader's settings in the server's place.

compose.uploading.description: Beside an image while its file uploads.

compose.processing.description: Beside an image while the server processes the uploaded file.

compose.upload_failed.defaultMessage: No se pudo completar la subida.
compose.upload_failed.description: Beside an image whose upload failed, before its retry button.

compose.media_failed.defaultMessage: No se pudo cargar la imagen.
compose.media_failed.description: Beside an image of a draft opened from the server whose file could not be loaded, before the button that loads it again (compose.retry); the draft still keeps it.

compose.retry.description: The button that uploads a failed image again, or loads again a draft's image that could not be loaded.

compose.remove.description: The button at the end of an image's row that takes it out of the post.

compose.wait_uploads.defaultMessage: Espera a que se suban todas las imágenes o quita las que fallaron.
compose.wait_uploads.description: The error before Post when it is pressed while an image uploads or failed to.

compose.poll.description: The caption of the poll's card in the composer.

compose.failed.defaultMessage: No se pudo publicar. Inténtalo de nuevo.
compose.failed.description: The error before Post when the post got no answer from the server (the network); pressing Post sends it again, once.

compose.discarded.description: The notice at the bottom of the page after the composer was closed with a written post, beside Undo.

compose.undo.description: The action of the discarded post's notice: it opens the composer again with the post.

compose.later.description: The name of the menu in the composer's head: keep this post as a draft, or open the drafts and scheduled posts.

compose.schedule.description: The caption of the form that sets the time a post goes out.

compose.schedule.field.description: The name, for assistive technology, of the field of the date and the time a post goes out.

compose.schedule.limits.defaultMessage: Desde {minutes, plural, one {# minuto} other {# minutos}} hasta {days, plural, one {# día} other {# días}} a partir de ahora
compose.schedule.limits.description: Under the schedule's field: the nearest and the farthest time the server takes.

compose.schedule.invalid.defaultMessage: Elige una fecha y una hora.
compose.schedule.invalid.description: Under the schedule's field when it holds no whole date and time.

compose.schedule.too_soon.defaultMessage: {minutes, plural, one {Programa la publicación con al menos # minuto de antelación.} other {Programa la publicación con al menos # minutos de antelación.}}
compose.schedule.too_soon.description: Under the schedule's field when the time is nearer than the server takes.

compose.schedule.too_far.defaultMessage: {days, plural, one {Programa la publicación con como máximo # día de antelación.} other {Programa la publicación con como máximo # días de antelación.}}
compose.schedule.too_far.description: Under the schedule's field when the time is farther than the server takes.

compose.schedule.set.description: The button of the schedule's form that sets the time the post goes out.

compose.schedule.clear.description: The neutral button of the schedule's form, while a time is set, that takes the time away, so that Post posts at once.

compose.schedule.item.description: A menu item that opens the form of the time a post goes out.

compose.schedule.change_item.description: A menu item that opens the form of the time of a post already scheduled.

compose.schedule.tool.description: The name of the composer's tool that opens the form of the time a post goes out.

compose.schedule.tool_set.description: The name of the composer's schedule tool while the post has a time: it opens the form to change the time.

compose.schedule.at.description: The line above the composer's Post while the post is scheduled and the form of its time is open, the form stating the zone; time is the weekday, date and time.

compose.schedule.at_zone.description: The line above the composer's Post while the post is scheduled, the one place the zone is stated; time is the weekday, date and time, zone the reader's time zone (Asia/Tokyo · GMT+9). Change time stands at the line's end.

compose.schedule.change.description: The action at the end of the line of a scheduled post's time, which opens its form.

compose.schedule.post.description: The composer's primary button while the post has a time: it schedules the post.

compose.schedule.failed.description: A draft whose scheduled post failed: time is when it was to go out, reason one of compose.schedule.failed.*.

compose.schedule.failed.restricted.defaultMessage: tu cuenta no puede publicar ahora
compose.schedule.failed.restricted.description: Why a scheduled post failed: the account may not post (a moderation action or a suspension).

compose.schedule.failed.reply_unavailabl.defaultMessage: la publicación a la que responde ya no está disponible
compose.schedule.failed.reply_unavailabl.description: Why a scheduled post failed: the post it replies to is gone, hidden, or takes no reply.

compose.schedule.failed.quote_unavailabl.defaultMessage: la publicación que cita ya no está disponible
compose.schedule.failed.quote_unavailabl.description: Why a scheduled post failed: the post it quotes is gone, hidden, or may not be quoted.

compose.schedule.failed.media_unavailabl.defaultMessage: un archivo adjunto ya no está disponible
compose.schedule.failed.media_unavailabl.description: Why a scheduled post failed: an attached file is gone or failed processing.

compose.schedule.failed.invalid.defaultMessage: no cumple los requisitos de una publicación
compose.schedule.failed.invalid.description: Why a scheduled post failed: it does not pass the checks of a post, such as its length.

compose.schedule.failed.rejected.defaultMessage: la revisión automática del servidor no la aceptó
compose.schedule.failed.rejected.description: Why a scheduled post failed: the server's automated review did not accept it.

compose.schedule.failed.next.defaultMessage: {failure}. Edítala si hace falta y luego publícala o prográmala de nuevo.
compose.schedule.failed.next.description: The composer's alert on a draft whose scheduled post failed: failure is compose.schedule.failed (when and why), followed by what the reader may do now.

compose.conflict.defaultMessage: Este borrador se guardó más tarde en otro dispositivo, así que tus cambios aquí no se guardaron.
compose.conflict.description: The composer's error when a save of a draft is refused for a newer one saved elsewhere.

compose.conflict.open.description: The action after compose.conflict, which opens the newer draft in place of this one.

compose.gone.defaultMessage: Este borrador ya no está en el servidor. Puede que se haya publicado; revisa tu perfil.
compose.gone.description: The composer's error when the draft it posts or schedules is no longer on the server (deleted elsewhere, or posted already by its schedule or by a post whose answer was lost); what was written stays in the composer, and its Post button reads compose.gone.post.

compose.gone.post.description: The composer's Post button after compose.gone: lets the draft that is no longer on the server go, and posts what is written now as a new post.

compose.drafts.description: The title of the composer's list of the reader's drafts and scheduled posts.

compose.drafts.save.description: A menu item that keeps what is written as a draft and closes the composer.

compose.drafts.open.description: A menu item that opens the list of the reader's drafts and scheduled posts.

compose.drafts.back.description: At the top of the list of drafts: back to the post being written.

compose.drafts.blank.description: A draft's row in place of its text, when it has only media or a poll.

compose.drafts.saved.description: When a draft was last saved, on its row: time is how long ago, as the list's relative times read it (Saved 2h ago, 3時間前に保存), or the date after a week.

compose.drafts.open_one.description: The name of a draft's row, which opens it in the composer.

compose.drafts.more.description: The name of the menu at the end of a draft's row.

compose.drafts.open_item.description: A draft's menu item that opens it in the composer.

compose.drafts.unschedule.description: A scheduled post's menu item that takes its time away: it becomes a draft.

compose.drafts.delete.description: A draft's menu item that deletes it, after asking.

compose.drafts.delete.title.description: The question before a draft is deleted.

compose.drafts.delete.text.defaultMessage: Se elimina de todos tus dispositivos. No se puede deshacer.

compose.drafts.delete.scheduled.defaultMessage: No se publicará y se elimina de todos tus dispositivos. No se puede deshacer.
compose.drafts.delete.scheduled.description: What follows deleting a scheduled post.

compose.drafts.delete.cancel.description: The refusal of deleting a draft.

compose.drafts.delete.confirm.description: The confirmation of deleting a draft.

compose.drafts.mark.reply.description: A mark on a draft's row: it replies to a post.

compose.drafts.mark.quote.description: A mark on a draft's row: it quotes a post.

compose.drafts.mark.media.description: A mark on a draft's row: how many files it attaches.

compose.drafts.mark.poll.description: A mark on a draft's row: it carries a poll.

compose.drafts.mark.article.description: A mark on a draft's row: it is the draft of an article.

compose.drafts.zone.description: Over the scheduled posts: the reader's time zone, in which their times read.

compose.drafts.empty.drafts.description: The drafts' section of the list when it has none, while there are scheduled posts.

compose.drafts.empty.defaultMessage: Aún no hay borradores ni publicaciones programadas.
compose.drafts.empty.description: The list of drafts and scheduled posts when it has neither.

compose.drafts.loading.description: The list of drafts while it loads.

compose.drafts.failed.defaultMessage: No se pudieron cargar los borradores.
compose.drafts.failed.description: The list of drafts when it failed to load.

compose.drafts.retry.description: After compose.drafts.failed: loads the list again.

compose.drafts.tab.drafts.description: The tab, or the heading, of the drafts, with how many.

compose.drafts.tab.scheduled.description: The tab, or the heading, of the scheduled posts, with how many.

compose.drafts.list.drafts.description: The name of the list of drafts, for assistive technology.

compose.drafts.list.scheduled.description: The name of the list of scheduled posts, for assistive technology.

compose.article.title.new.description: The title of the article editor, a screen of its own, while it writes a new article.

compose.article.title.edit.description: The title of the article editor while it edits the reader's published article.

compose.article.mode.description: The name of the switch, on a narrow screen, between writing the article and its preview.

compose.article.mode.write.description: The choice of the switch that shows what is written of the article.

compose.article.mode.preview.description: The choice of the switch that shows the article as it will be published.

compose.article.preview.caption.description: The caption over the preview of the article, beside what is written on a wide screen.

compose.article.preview.failed.defaultMessage: No se pudo mostrar la vista previa.
compose.article.preview.failed.description: In the preview's place when the server did not render the body; followed by Try again.

compose.article.preview.empty.description: In the preview's place while the body is empty.

compose.article.field.title.description: The name of the article's title field, and its placeholder.

compose.article.field.title.over.defaultMessage: El título debe tener como máximo {max, number} caracteres.
compose.article.field.title.over.description: Under the title when it is longer than the limit.

compose.article.field.title.missing.description: Under the title when Publish was pressed without one.

compose.article.field.left.description: What a count near a field's limit says to a screen reader: how many characters are left.

compose.article.field.over.defaultMessage: {count, plural, one {# carácter de más} other {# caracteres de más}}
compose.article.field.over.description: What a count past a field's limit says to a screen reader: by how many characters it is over.

compose.article.body.description: The name of the article's body, written in Markdown.

compose.article.body.placeholder.description: The placeholder of the article's body.

compose.article.body.missing.description: Under the body when Publish was pressed with no body.

compose.article.details.description: The heading of the article's summary, cover and hashtags, after its body.

compose.article.summary.description: The name of the article's summary field.

compose.article.summary.hint.defaultMessage: Si lo dejas vacío, se usa el comienzo del cuerpo.
compose.article.summary.hint.description: Under the summary's label: what an empty summary becomes.

compose.article.summary.placeholder.defaultMessage: De qué trata el artículo, en una o dos líneas
compose.article.summary.placeholder.description: The placeholder of the summary field.

compose.article.summary.over.defaultMessage: El resumen debe tener como máximo {max, number} caracteres.
compose.article.summary.over.description: Under the summary when it is longer than the limit.

compose.article.cover.description: The name of the article's cover image.

compose.article.cover.add.description: The button that picks the article's cover image.

compose.article.cover.remove.description: The button that takes the cover image off the article.

compose.article.cover.description.description: The label of the cover image's description, for those who cannot see it.

compose.article.cover.description.hint.defaultMessage: Qué muestra la imagen, para quienes no pueden verla
compose.article.cover.description.hint.description: The placeholder of the cover image's description.

compose.article.cover.waiting.defaultMessage: Espera a que se suba la imagen de portada o quítala si la subida falló.
compose.article.cover.waiting.description: Before Publish when Publish was pressed while the cover uploads or failed to.

compose.article.tags.description: The name of the article's hashtags.

compose.article.tags.placeholder.description: The placeholder of the field that adds a hashtag.

compose.article.tags.full.description: The placeholder of the hashtags' field once the article has as many as it can.

compose.article.tags.remove.description: The button on a hashtag that takes it off the article.

compose.article.tags.left.defaultMessage: {count, plural, one {# etiqueta más} other {# etiquetas más}}
compose.article.tags.left.description: Beside the hashtags' label once near their limit: how many more can be added.

compose.article.limit.bytes.description: How much of the length limit of the article's body is used, as a percentage; past 100% the article is too long to publish.

compose.article.limit.images.description: How many images the article's body has, of the most it may have.

compose.article.attach.description: The tool that uploads an image and puts it in the body.

compose.article.attach.uploading.defaultMessage: {count, plural, one {Subiendo una imagen…} other {Subiendo # imágenes…}}
compose.article.attach.uploading.description: Under the body while images for it upload.

compose.article.attach.failed.defaultMessage: No se pudo subir una imagen. Intenta añadirla de nuevo.
compose.article.attach.failed.description: Under the body when an image for it could not be uploaded.

compose.article.sensitive.on.description: The tool that folds the article's body and cover behind its title and summary.

compose.article.sensitive.off.description: The same tool while the article is marked sensitive.

compose.article.publish.description: The button that publishes the article now.

compose.article.gone.publish.description: The button that publishes what is written as a new article, once its draft is gone from the server.

compose.article.over.defaultMessage: Una parte del artículo supera su límite. Acórtala o quita imágenes para publicar.
compose.article.over.description: Before Publish when the article is over a limit.

compose.article.missing.defaultMessage: Ponle un título y un cuerpo al artículo para publicarlo.
compose.article.missing.description: Before Publish when Publish was pressed without a title or a body.

compose.article.failed.defaultMessage: No se pudo publicar. Inténtalo de nuevo.
compose.article.failed.description: Before Publish when publishing failed with no word from the server.

compose.article.not_allowed.defaultMessage: Tu cuenta no puede escribir artículos nuevos en este servidor. Aún puedes editar los que escribiste antes.
compose.article.not_allowed.description: In place of the editor when the reader may not write new articles.

compose.article.loading.description: In place of the editor while the article or its draft is read from the server.

compose.article.load_failed.defaultMessage: No se pudo cargar el artículo.
compose.article.load_failed.description: In place of the editor when the article or its draft could not be read; followed by Try again.

compose.in_place.to.description: Over the reply in place at the end of a conversation of direct messages: whom it goes to. names lists the conversation's other people.

compose.in_place.form.description: The name of the reply in place at the end of a conversation of direct messages, a form, for assistive technology. names lists the conversation's other people.

compose.in_place.label.description: The name of the text field of the reply in place at the end of a conversation of direct messages, for assistive technology.

compose.in_place.placeholder.description: The placeholder of the empty reply in place at the end of a conversation of direct messages.

compose.in_place.send.description: The button that sends the reply in place at the end of a conversation of direct messages.

compose.in_place.send_to.description: The name of the button that sends the reply in place, for assistive technology, apart from every post's Reply; it starts with, or holds, the button's visible word (compose.in_place.send). names lists the conversation's other people.

compose.audience_menu.description: The name of the audience menu of the composer and of the article editor, over its two items: who can see the post or the article, and who can reply to, boost and quote it. Reply stands for the three; the item says them all.

compose.refused.appeal.description: The action after the error of a post or an article that this server's automated review refused, in the composer and in the article editor (the server's sentence ends with: If you think this is a mistake, you can appeal). It opens the confirmation compose.refused.appeal.title.

compose.refused.reviewed.defaultMessage: Esta publicación no se publicó: la revisión automática de este servidor no la aceptó.
compose.refused.reviewed.description: The error of a post that this server's automated review refused, in the composer, where the app offers the appeal: the action Appeal follows it on the same line (compose.refused.appeal), so the sentence does not say that the reader can appeal. It stands for the server's own sentence (server:errors.status.rejected.detail), which says so for an app with no such action.

compose.refused.appeal.title.description: The question of the confirmation before the reader appeals the refusal of their post or article by this server's automated review, in the composer and in the article editor.

compose.refused.appeal.text.defaultMessage: El texto de tu publicación se envía a los moderadores de este servidor, que lo revisan. Solo puedes apelar un rechazo una vez. No se puede deshacer.
compose.refused.appeal.text.description: The text of the confirmation compose.refused.appeal.title for a post, in the composer: what appealing sends and to whom, that a refusal is appealed once, and that it cannot be undone. The optional field compose.refused.appeal.comment follows it, whose label says that what is written there goes to the moderators too.

compose.refused.appeal.confirm.description: The button of the confirmation compose.refused.appeal.title that sends the appeal of the refused post. In ja it is short enough to stand beside Cancel in the dialog on a narrow phone.

compose.refused.appeal.cancel.description: The button of the confirmation compose.refused.appeal.title that closes it without appealing.

compose.refused.appeal.comment.defaultMessage: Lo que deberían saber los moderadores (opcional)
compose.refused.appeal.comment.description: The label of the field in the confirmation compose.refused.appeal.title where the reader may write what the moderators should know about the refused post or article (why it should be let through). It may stay empty; what is written is sent with the appeal.

compose.refused.appeal.comment.hint.description: The hint under the label compose.refused.appeal.comment. max is the most characters the server takes (2000).

compose.refused.appeal.comment.over.defaultMessage: Acorta lo que escribiste a {max, number} caracteres o menos.
compose.refused.appeal.comment.over.description: The error under the field compose.refused.appeal.comment when what the reader wrote is longer than the server takes, as they press Send appeal: nothing is sent. max is the most characters (2000).

compose.refused.appeal.state.defaultMessage: {state, select, pending {Esta publicación no se publicó. Tu apelación se envió y se te avisará del resultado. Si los moderadores levantan el rechazo, vuelve a publicarla. Para conservarla hasta entonces, guárdala como borrador.} upheld {Esta publicación no se publicó. Un moderador revisó tu apelación y mantuvo el rechazo. Cambia la publicación e inténtalo de nuevo.} overturned {Un moderador revisó tu apelación y levantó el rechazo. Vuelve a publicar.} other {Esta publicación no se publicó. Apelaste el rechazo.}}
compose.refused.appeal.state.description: In place of the error of a post that this server's automated review refused, in the composer, once the reader appealed the refusal: where the appeal stands. state is pending (sent, waiting for the moderators: Post is disabled until the post is changed; the server keeps no refused post, so the reader posts it again once the refusal is lifted, and keeps it meanwhile with Save as draft, compose.drafts.save), upheld (the refusal stays; Post is disabled until the post is changed), or overturned (the moderators cancelled the refusal: Post, right after this sentence, posts it again).

compose.refused.appeal.failed.defaultMessage: {reason, select, appealed {Ya apelaste este rechazo y solo se puede apelar una vez. Espera la notificación del resultado.} closed {Pasó el plazo para apelar este rechazo. Cambia la publicación e inténtalo de nuevo.} not_appealable {Este rechazo ya no se puede apelar. Cambia la publicación e inténtalo de nuevo.} text {Esta publicación no tiene texto que enviar a los moderadores, así que no se puede apelar. Cambia la publicación e inténtalo de nuevo.} other {No se pudo enviar la apelación. Comprueba tu conexión e inténtalo de nuevo.}}
compose.refused.appeal.failed.description: In place of the error of a post that this server's automated review refused, in the composer, when the appeal the reader sent was not taken. reason is appealed (appealed already), closed (the last moment to appeal has passed), not_appealable (the refusal cannot be appealed, or is not kept any more), text (the post has no text, which an appeal must carry), or other (the server could not be reached).

compose.article.refused.reviewed.defaultMessage: Este artículo no se publicó: la revisión automática de este servidor no lo aceptó.
compose.article.refused.reviewed.description: The error of an article that this server's automated review refused, in the article editor, where the app offers the appeal: the action Appeal follows it on the same line (compose.refused.appeal), so the sentence does not say that the reader can appeal. The article's counterpart of compose.refused.reviewed.

compose.article.refused.appeal.text.defaultMessage: El cuerpo de tu artículo se envía a los moderadores de este servidor, que lo revisan. Solo puedes apelar un rechazo una vez. No se puede deshacer.
compose.article.refused.appeal.text.description: The text of the confirmation compose.refused.appeal.title for an article, in the article editor: what appealing sends (the article's body, not its title or summary) and to whom, that a refusal is appealed once, and that it cannot be undone. The article's counterpart of compose.refused.appeal.text.

compose.article.refused.appeal.state.defaultMessage: {state, select, pending {Este artículo no se publicó. Tu apelación se envió y se te avisará del resultado. Si los moderadores levantan el rechazo, vuelve a publicarlo. Para conservarlo hasta entonces, guárdalo como borrador.} upheld {Este artículo no se publicó. Un moderador revisó tu apelación y mantuvo el rechazo. Cambia el artículo e inténtalo de nuevo.} overturned {Un moderador revisó tu apelación y levantó el rechazo. Vuelve a publicar.} other {Este artículo no se publicó. Apelaste el rechazo.}}
compose.article.refused.appeal.state.description: In place of the error of an article that this server's automated review refused, in the article editor, once the reader appealed the refusal: where the appeal stands. state is pending (sent, waiting for the moderators: Publish is disabled until the article is changed; the server keeps no refused article, so the reader publishes it again once the refusal is lifted, and keeps it meanwhile with Save as draft, compose.drafts.save), upheld (the refusal stays; Publish is disabled until the article is changed), or overturned (the moderators cancelled the refusal: Publish, right after this sentence, publishes it again). The article's counterpart of compose.refused.appeal.state.

compose.article.refused.appeal.failed.defaultMessage: {reason, select, appealed {Ya apelaste este rechazo y solo se puede apelar una vez. Espera la notificación del resultado.} closed {Pasó el plazo para apelar este rechazo. Cambia el artículo e inténtalo de nuevo.} not_appealable {Este rechazo ya no se puede apelar. Cambia el artículo e inténtalo de nuevo.} text {Este artículo no tiene cuerpo que enviar a los moderadores, así que no se puede apelar. Cambia el artículo e inténtalo de nuevo.} other {No se pudo enviar la apelación. Comprueba tu conexión e inténtalo de nuevo.}}
compose.article.refused.appeal.failed.description: In place of the error of an article that this server's automated review refused, in the article editor, when the appeal the reader sent was not taken. reason is appealed (appealed already), closed (the last moment to appeal has passed), not_appealable (the refusal cannot be appealed, or is not kept any more), text (the article has no body, which an appeal must carry), or other (the server could not be reached). The article's counterpart of compose.refused.appeal.failed.
